_comment: TODO: confirm the exact /dev/ttyUSBn via `ls /dev/tty*` before/after plugging in the PMS7003's USB-TTL adapter. GPIO14/15 (/dev/ttyAMA0 or /dev/serial0) is NOT available for this sensor - that built-in UART is permanently dedicated to the SmartElex HMI touchscreen (see edge/hmi_map.json / HMI_PORT), so the PMS7003 needs its own USB-to-TTL adapter instead. These sensor_ids match seed/seed.py's SENSORS list - all three point at the same physical unit, so they share one device value once it's filled in.
